categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two segments: touch display module automation equipment and automotive intelligent manufacturing equipment. The touch display module segment includes high-precision bonding, dispensing, bending, laminating, and inspection equipment for 3C modules. The automotive segment focuses on automatic detection, assembly, cleaning, filtering, logistics, and multi-station specialized processing equipment for automotive powertrains.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary R&D with a structured innovation system, focusing on high-precision automation technologies such as full-automatic COG, FOG, COF bonding equipment, AOI inspection, laser sintering, and intelligent torque control systems. Production is customer-driven with customized design and manufacturing, employing distributed production bases to enhance responsiveness and efficiency. The company also invests in OLED-related technologies and laser radar assembly equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and international first-tier display panel and module manufacturers, as well as automotive companies like Dongfeng Honda. The end markets served are primarily consumer electronics (smartphones, computers, wearable devices), automotive display panels, and automotive powertrain manufacturing. The company’s products support assembly and inspection processes in these industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant sales in East China, Central China, Southwest China, and some overseas markets. It has production and R&D bases in Dalian, Shenzhen, Wuhan, Xiaogan, and Hong Kong. The geographic sales distribution shows strong presence in Chinese regions with growing industrial demand.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing specialized automation equipment used by downstream display panel and module manufacturers and automotive component producers. It provides customized equipment solutions integral to the assembly and testing stages of the manufacturing process.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening R&D innovation, focusing on OLED and semiconductor-related equipment, enhancing product quality and cost efficiency, and expanding into new application fields such as laser radar and AR/VR optical components. The company plans to increase OLED-related equipment revenue share and improve core technology barriers while optimizing internal controls and cost management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of customized automation equipment based on customer orders. The company also earns from related technical support services and occasional sales of materials and components. The sales model is predominantly order-based direct sales with a focus on maintaining strong customer relationships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the few domestic providers of customized intelligent manufacturing solutions in the touch display module automation equipment niche, holding a competitive edge in bonding, dispensing, bending, laminating, and inspection equipment. It competes with both domestic and international equipment manufacturers amid increasing market competition and price pressures, benefiting from the domestic panel industry’s growth and import substitution trends.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 384 million, a 19.41% decline from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 129 million. Total assets were RMB 889 million, down 19.88%, and net assets were RMB 492 million, down 21.44%. The company experienced significant impairment losses and increased provisions impacting profitability, but operating cash flow improved substantially. The company is mid-sized with a challenging growth profile due to industry demand fluctuations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced, high-precision, and customizable automation equipment tailored to specific customer processes in the touch display and automotive sectors. It leverages strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent holdings, and close collaboration with leading panel manufacturers to deliver integrated intelligent manufacturing solutions. Its brand is recognized for quality, innovation, and comprehensive service, supporting domestic industry upgrading and import substitution.
